# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 and packaged docs** · Released October 12, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.154.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates to Skia m154 and ships source-authored XML API documentation with managed assemblies. It corrects native glyph-atlas and GPU failure handling. Review the HarfBuzzSharp enum migrations and the removal of RAW/DNG decoding before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **HarfBuzz combining-class spelling corrected** — Replace UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 with CCC132. The numeric value remains 132; no compatibility alias is retained. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **HarfBuzz aggregate glyph flag removed** — GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete flags required by your application instead. The aggregate BufferFlags.Defined and SerializeFlag.Defined masks are not introduced. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **Built-in RAW and DNG decoding removed** — RAW/DNG development and extraction of embedded JPEG previews are no longer supported. Use a separate RAW decoder or convert files before loading them. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains its value of 10 for compatibility, but does not indicate codec support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged. ([#5190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5190))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to m154** — Includes upstream Ganesh clipping, Graphite triangle-strip, and SVG color-filter improvements while preserving existing C exports. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## API Surface

- **HarfBuzz enum values match the bundled engine** — Synchronizes supported buffer, cluster, glyph, and baseline-tag values with HarfBuzz 14.2.1. Callback-heavy API families and new unwrapped native types remain excluded. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **API documentation travels with reference assemblies** — NuGet packages include matching compiler XML beside implementation and reference assemblies, making source-authored API guidance available to package consumers. ([#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053))

## Bug Fixes

- **Glyph-atlas updates and failed GPU work handled consistently** — Avoids stale glyph-atlas reuse and propagates failed prerequisite flushes through existing null/false contracts. Failed uploads drop affected draws, and failed flushes clear uniquely held cache entries. ([#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114), [#5253](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5253))
- **Uno WebAssembly uses matching HarfBuzz native assets** — The Uno views package depends on the matching HarfBuzz WebAssembly assets rather than an older implicit archive missing required symbols. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **Windows HarfBuzz binaries pass BinSkim BA2007** — Consumers no longer need to baseline the disabled-critical-warnings error in libHarfBuzzSharp.dll. The native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected. — ❤️ [@azchohfi](https://github.com/azchohfi) ([#5111](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5111))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

Synchronizes supported enums with native HarfBuzz 14.2.1, correcting CCC133 to CCC132 and removing GlyphFlags.Defined. Adds source-authored compiler XML and fixes Windows BinSkim BA2007 and Uno WebAssembly native-asset matching; the .400 package revision does not upgrade the engine.
